selected_candidate.name: 3D Photography using Context-aware Layered Depth Inpainting

official_pipeline.representation: Layered Depth Image (LDI) with explicit pixel connectivity
order: detect and extend depth discontinuity edges in local occlusion regions
inpaint depth conditioned on completed edges
inpaint RGB conditioned on completed edges

network_inputs.edge: RGB + normalized disparity + known edge + context + hole mask
network_inputs.depth: depth + completed edge + context + hole mask
network_inputs.color: RGB + completed edge + context + hole mask

official_pipeline.important_limit: The official networks operate on local LDI-derived connected components and background-side context. They are not an official arbitrary full-frame RGB-plus-mask API.

compatibility.official_environment: Ubuntu 18.04, Python 3.7, PyTorch 1.4.0, torchvision 0.5.0, CUDA toolkit 10.1
